          if ! podman login --get-login image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 &> /dev/null; then
            pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".password /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
            podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:1:-1} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false
          fi

          export DAEMON_IMG="DAEMON_IMAGE"
          export SIDECAR_IMG="SIDECAR_IMAGE"

            git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/ptp-operator.git

          sed -i "s/\(CGO_ENABLED=\${CGO_ENABLED}\) \(GOOS=\${GOOS}\)/\1 CC=\"gcc -fuse-ld=gold\" \2/" hack/build.sh
          # For UPSTREAM use Dockerfile for upstream contents
          if [[ "$T5CI_VERSION" =~ 4.1[2-8]+ || "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" Dockerfile
            make docker-build

---

**TL;DR:** Transient T-GM GNSS instability on cnfdf32 caused 17 of 18 failures; 1 is a deterministic WPC NIC lab misconfiguration.

**Overall Issue Class:** infra_other

---

**TL;DR:** All 6 failures are lab/hardware problems: GNSS loss on T-GM node, T-BC topology undiscoverable, DualNICBCHA log timeout.

**Overall Issue Class:** infra_other
**Overall Severity:** MEDIUM

## Root Causes (6 failures across 1 suites)

### 3/6 failures — T-GM node stuck in FREERUN (no GNSS lock)
- **Suites:** all+dualnicbcha+tbc+tgm | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** Node `cnfdf32` remained at clockClass 248 (FREERUN) for the entire tgm run (08:27–08:35); all three tgm tests require a GNSS-locked baseline (clockClass ≤ 7). `ptp.go:4061/4157/4185`.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** Possible — intermittent GNSS antenna/receiver condition in lab; no historical recurrence data.
- **Fix:** Verify GNSS antenna/receiver on `cnfdf32.telco5gran.eng.rdu2.redhat.com` is physically connected and rerun once clockClass 6/7 is confirmed in ts2phc logs.

### 2/6 failures — T-BC topology not discoverable
- **Suites:** all+dualnicbcha+tbc+tgm | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** `SynchronizedBeforeSuite` aborted with "no T-BC solution found for TBC" (`ptp.go:367`, `parallel_suite_test.go:59`), cascading to the tbc reboot-discovery test.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** No — deterministic topology-discovery failure aborted tbc suite setup entirely.
- **Fix:** Check T-BC node PtpConfig and hardware provisioning in the lab; confirm topology satisfies discovery requirements before rerunning.

### 1/6 failures — DualNICBCHA daemon log read timeout
- **Suites:** all+dualnicbcha+tbc+tgm | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** `[dualnicbcha-serial]` phc2sys failover test timed out reading linuxptp daemon logs; log subsystem was unresponsive or slow.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** Possible — intermittent infra/log-collection slowness.
- **Fix:** Check linuxptp daemon log availability on the DualNICBCHA node; retry if transient.

## Summary Table

| # | Test | Suite | Group | Classification | Confidence | Root Cause (one line) | Fix |
|---|------|-------|-------|---------------|------------|----------------------|-----|
| 1 | WPC T-GM holdover connection loss | tgm-serial | 1 | infra_other | medium | GNSS not locking on cnfdf32 (clockClass 248) | Fix GNSS antenna, rerun |
| 2 | ts2phc termination FREERUN recovery | tgm-serial | 1 | infra_other | medium | GNSS not locking on cnfdf32 (clockClass 248) | Fix GNSS antenna, rerun |
| 3 | T-GM Events GNSS reboot/recovery | tgm-serial | 1 | infra_other | medium | GNSS not locking on cnfdf32 (clockClass 248) | Fix GNSS antenna, rerun |
| 4 | [SynchronizedBeforeSuite] | tbc | 2 | infra_other | medium | No T-BC solution found, suite aborted | Fix T-BC topology config |
| 5 | TBC slave node reboot discovery | tbc-serial | 2 | infra_other | medium | Cascade from SynchronizedBeforeSuite failure | Fix T-BC topology config |
| 6 | DualNICBCHA phc2sys secondary failover | dualnicbcha-serial | 3 | infra_other | medium | Daemon log read timeout | Check log subsystem, retry |

## Action Items
1. **Lab team:** Inspect GNSS antenna/receiver on `cnfdf32.telco5gran.eng.rdu2.redhat.com`; confirm clockClass 6/7 in ts2phc logs before rerunning tgm suite (unblocks 3 failures).
2. **Lab team:** Diagnose T-BC topology discovery failure — verify T-BC node PtpConfig and hardware meet test prerequisites (unblocks 2 failures).
3. **Lab team:** Check linuxptp daemon log responsiveness on DualNICBCHA node; retry the dualnicbcha test if transient.

## Open Questions
None. All root causes are consistent lab/hardware failures within a single combined suite analysis. No serial-passed/parallel-failed paradox observed. No cross-suite contradictions. No code changes identified as contributing.

          # Used for 4.15 and older releases.
          if ! podman login --get-login image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 &> /dev/null; then
            pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".password /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
            podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:1:-1} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false
          fi

          set -x

          export IMG=PTP_IMAGE
          export DAEMON_IMG="DAEMON_IMAGE"
          export SIDECAR_IMG="SIDECAR_IMAGE"

          export T5CI_VERSION="T5CI_VERSION_VAL"
          export USE_UPSTREAM="USE_UPSTREAM_VAL"

          # run latest release on upstream main branch
          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "Running on upstream main branch"
            git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/ptp-operator.git
          else
            git clone --single-branch --branch OPERATOR_VERSION https://github.com/openshift/ptp-operator.git
          fi
          cd ptp-operator
          # OCPBUGS-52327 fix build due to libresolv.so link error
          sed -i "s/\(CGO_ENABLED=\${CGO_ENABLED}\) \(GOOS=\${GOOS}\)/\1 CC=\"gcc -fuse-ld=gold\" \2/" hack/build.sh
          # For UPSTREAM use Dockerfile for upstream contents
          if [[ "$T5CI_VERSION" =~ 4.1[2-8]+ || "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" Dockerfile
            make docker-build
          else
            # Dockerfile is updated to upstream in 4.19+. Use .ocp or .ci versions for non-UPSTREAM runs
            if [ -f "Dockerfile.ocp" ]; then
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ocp"
            else
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ci"
            fi
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" "$DOCKERFILE"
            podman build -t "${IMG}" -f "$DOCKERFILE"
          fi
          podman push ${IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "false" ]]; then
            # If we a running a downstream run we are done
            exit 0
          fi

          # If were running upstream we should also use the upstream daemon!
          echo "Running on upstream main branch of linuxptp-daemon"
          git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/linuxptp-daemon.git
          cd linuxptp-daemon

          IMAGE_TAG_BASE="${DAEMON_IMG%:*}" VERSION="${DAEMON_IMG##*:}" make image
          podman push ${DAEMON_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          echo "Running on main branch of cloud-event-proxy"
          git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/redhat-cne/cloud-event-proxy.git
          cd cloud-event-proxy
          IMG=${SIDECAR_IMG} make podman-build
          podman push ${SIDECAR_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

      securityContext:
        privileged: true
      volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push
          name: dockercfg
          readOnly: true
        - name: secret-volume

  volumes:
    - name: secret-volume

        items:
        - key: .dockerconfigjson
          path: config.json

    - name: dockercfg
      secret:
        secretName: BUILDER_DOCKERCFG
        defaultMode: 384

---

**TL;DR:** All 7 failures are likely transient — 4 from GNSS/hardware setup panic, 3 from lab topology and timing flakes.

**Overall Issue Class:** test_flake
**Overall Severity:** MEDIUM

## Root Causes (7 failures across 2 suites)

### 4/7 failures — T-GM GNSS hardware/setup panic (all tgm-serial tests)
- **Suites:** tgm | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** All 4 tests report Ginkgo `result: error` (panic/unhandled exception, not assertion failure), indicating test setup failed before any assertions ran — consistent with GNSS signal unavailability or ts2phc initialization failure on the WPC GM node.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** Yes — investigation-summary.txt explicitly calls this transient; no `release-5.0` code change identified.
- **Fix:** Retry the job; if failures recur, verify GNSS signal and ts2phc health on cnfdf30/31/32 before tgm suite starts.

### 1/7 failures — TBC topology not discoverable at setup time
- **Suites:** dualfollower+dualnicbcha+tbc | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** BeforeEach at `ptp.go:367` hard-fails (not skips) with `no T-BC solution found for TBC`; all 6 debug polls returned `Ports getting PTP frames=[]`, meaning no upstream PTP source was reachable for the graph solver.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown (lab state, not a code change)
- **Flake?** Yes — lab topology dependency; transient loss of upstream PTP source triggers a hard-fail instead of a graceful skip.
- **Fix:** Add a pre-suite health check that skips (not fails) the TBC block when `Ports getting PTP frames=[]`.

### 1/7 failures — Dual-follower port stuck in LISTENING after recovery
- **Suites:** dualfollower+dualnicbcha+tbc | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** ens2f1np1 on cnfdf31 never transitioned from LISTENING→SLAVE within 300s after being brought back up; grandmaster `b49691.fffe.a9af9d` was reachable (ens2f0np0 was LOCKED), so this is a PTP BMC re-convergence timing issue (`ptptesthelper.go:826`).
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** Yes — re-convergence time is environment-dependent; 300s timeout may be insufficient under some lab conditions.
- **Fix:** Increase the 300s SLAVE-recovery timeout or add a retry loop in `ptptesthelper.go:826`.

### 1/7 failures — phc2sys secondary interface switch timeout
- **Suites:** dualfollower+dualnicbcha+tbc | **Evidence:** HYPOTHESIS (per-suite detail truncated in evidence set)
- **What:** phc2sys did not switch to the secondary interface within the test deadline; root cause details were not fully captured in the available evidence.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** Yes (per suite classification: test_flake)
- **Fix:** Investigate phc2sys switchover deadline in the dualnicbcha scenario; extend timeout or add retry.

## Summary Table

| # | Test | Suite | Group | Classification | Confidence | Root Cause (one line) | Fix |
|---|------|-------|-------|---------------|------------|----------------------|-----|
| 1 | Verify ts2phc metrics cleanup ... | tgm | 1 | infra_other | low | GNSS/ts2phc setup panic before assertions | Retry; check GNSS signal |
| 2 | WPC T-GM holdover through connection loss | tgm | 1 | infra_other | low | GNSS/ts2phc setup panic before assertions | Retry; check GNSS signal |
| 3 | Continuously terminating ts2phc → FREERUN | tgm | 1 | infra_other | low | GNSS/ts2phc setup panic before assertions | Retry; check GNSS signal |
| 4 | T-GM Events on GNSS reboot and recovery | tgm | 1 | infra_other | low | GNSS/ts2phc setup panic before assertions | Retry; check GNSS signal |
| 5 | tbc-serial: slave node rebooted and synced | tbc | 2 | test_flake | medium | No PTP frames → BeforeEach hard-fail at ptp.go:367 | Skip instead of fail when no upstream PTP |
| 6 | dualfollower-serial: one follower port goes down | dualfollower | 3 | test_flake | medium | ens2f1np1 stuck LISTENING >300s post-recovery | Increase timeout at ptptesthelper.go:826 |
| 7 | dualnicbcha: phc2sys secondary switch | dualnicbcha | 4 | test_flake | low | phc2sys failed to switch to secondary interface in time | Extend/retry phc2sys switchover deadline |

## Action Items
1. **Infra/lab team:** Investigate GNSS signal health on tgm nodes (cnfdf30/31/32) and upstream TBC PTP source availability around 02:33 UTC; both tgm and TBC failures point to lab signal instability in the same run window.
2. **Test author (ptp.go):** Change TBC BeforeEach to `Skip` instead of `Fail` when `Ports getting PTP frames=[]`, preventing hard-failing 40+ downstream tests on a transient lab condition.
3. **Test author (ptptesthelper.go:826):** Increase dual-follower SLAVE-recovery timeout beyond 300s (or add a retry with backoff) to reduce environment-dependent flakes.

## Open Questions
- The tgm and TBC failures overlap in time (both appear to lose their upstream PTP/GNSS sources in the same job run). A shared lab-level signal outage is plausible but unverified — no cross-suite timestamp correlation evidence was available. Hypothesis only: if confirmed, both Groups 1 and 2 collapse into a single lab infra event.
- Group 4 (phc2sys) evidence was truncated in the prompt input; confidence is LOW. Per-suite analysis for dualnicbcha should be reviewed directly before acting on that fix.
- No contradictions between per-suite classifications were found; all suites independently converge on flake/transient.

          podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:8} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false

          # Used for 4.15 and older releases.
          if ! podman login --get-login image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 &> /dev/null; then
            pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".password /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
            podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:1:-1} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false
          fi

          set -x

          export IMG=PTP_IMAGE
          export DAEMON_IMG="DAEMON_IMAGE"
          export SIDECAR_IMG="SIDECAR_IMAGE"

          export T5CI_VERSION="T5CI_VERSION_VAL"
          export USE_UPSTREAM="USE_UPSTREAM_VAL"

          # run latest release on upstream main branch
          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "Running on upstream main branch"
            git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/ptp-operator.git

            git clone --single-branch --branch OPERATOR_VERSION https://github.com/openshift/ptp-operator.git
          fi
          cd ptp-operator
          # OCPBUGS-52327 fix build due to libresolv.so link error
          sed -i "s/\(CGO_ENABLED=\${CGO_ENABLED}\) \(GOOS=\${GOOS}\)/\1 CC=\"gcc -fuse-ld=gold\" \2/" hack/build.sh
          # For UPSTREAM use Dockerfile for upstream contents
          if [[ "$T5CI_VERSION" =~ 4.1[2-8]+ || "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" Dockerfile
            make docker-build
          else
            # Dockerfile is updated to upstream in 4.19+. Use .ocp or .ci versions for non-UPSTREAM runs
            if [ -f "Dockerfile.ocp" ]; then
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ocp"
            else
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ci"
            fi
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" "$DOCKERFILE"
            podman build -t "${IMG}" -f "$DOCKERFILE"
          fi
          podman push ${IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "false" ]]; then
            # If we a running a downstream run we are done
            exit 0
          fi

          # If were running upstream we should also use the upstream daemon!
          echo "Running on upstream main branch of linuxptp-daemon"
          git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/linuxptp-daemon.git
          cd linuxptp-daemon
          # Split DAEMON_IMG into IMAGE_TAG_BASE and VERSION because
          # hack/build-image.sh unconditionally overwrites IMG from these two vars.
          IMAGE_TAG_BASE="${DAEMON_IMG%:*}" VERSION="${DAEMON_IMG##*:}" make image
          podman push ${DAEMON_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          echo "Running on main branch of cloud-event-proxy"
          git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/redhat-cne/cloud-event-proxy.git
          cd cloud-event-proxy
          IMG=${SIDECAR_IMG} make podman-build
          podman push ${SIDECAR_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

      securityContext:
        privileged: true
      volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push
          name: dockercfg
          readOnly: true
        - name: secret-volume
          mountPath: /root/.docker
  volumes:
    - name: secret-volume

        secretName: pull-secret
        items:
        - key: .dockerconfigjson
          path: config.json

    - name: dockercfg
      secret:
        secretName: BUILDER_DOCKERCFG
        defaultMode: 384

---

**TL;DR:** All 7 failures are likely transient — 4 from GNSS/hardware setup panic, 3 from lab topology and timing flakes.

**Overall Issue Class:** test_flake
**Overall Severity:** MEDIUM

## Root Causes (7 failures across 2 suites)

### 4/7 failures — T-GM GNSS hardware/setup panic (all tgm-serial tests)
- **Suites:** tgm | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** All 4 tests report Ginkgo `result: error` (panic/unhandled exception, not assertion failure), indicating test setup failed before any assertions ran — consistent with GNSS signal unavailability or ts2phc initialization failure on the WPC GM node.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** Yes — investigation-summary.txt explicitly calls this transient; no `release-5.0` code change identified.
- **Fix:** Retry the job; if failures recur, verify GNSS signal and ts2phc health on cnfdf30/31/32 before tgm suite starts.

### 1/7 failures — TBC topology not discoverable at setup time
- **Suites:** dualfollower+dualnicbcha+tbc | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** BeforeEach at `ptp.go:367` hard-fails (not skips) with `no T-BC solution found for TBC`; all 6 debug polls returned `Ports getting PTP frames=[]`, meaning no upstream PTP source was reachable for the graph solver.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown (lab state, not a code change)
- **Flake?** Yes — lab topology dependency; transient loss of upstream PTP source triggers a hard-fail instead of a graceful skip.
- **Fix:** Add a pre-suite health check that skips (not fails) the TBC block when `Ports getting PTP frames=[]`.

### 1/7 failures — Dual-follower port stuck in LISTENING after recovery
- **Suites:** dualfollower+dualnicbcha+tbc | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** ens2f1np1 on cnfdf31 never transitioned from LISTENING→SLAVE within 300s after being brought back up; grandmaster `b49691.fffe.a9af9d` was reachable (ens2f0np0 was LOCKED), so this is a PTP BMC re-convergence timing issue (`ptptesthelper.go:826`).
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** Yes — re-convergence time is environment-dependent; 300s timeout may be insufficient under some lab conditions.
- **Fix:** Increase the 300s SLAVE-recovery timeout or add a retry loop in `ptptesthelper.go:826`.

### 1/7 failures — phc2sys secondary interface switch timeout
- **Suites:** dualfollower+dualnicbcha+tbc | **Evidence:** HYPOTHESIS (per-suite detail truncated in evidence set)
- **What:** phc2sys did not switch to the secondary interface within the test deadline; root cause details were not fully captured in the available evidence.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown
- **Flake?** Yes (per suite classification: test_flake)
- **Fix:** Investigate phc2sys switchover deadline in the dualnicbcha scenario; extend timeout or add retry.

## Summary Table

| # | Test | Suite | Group | Classification | Confidence | Root Cause (one line) | Fix |
|---|------|-------|-------|---------------|------------|----------------------|-----|
| 1 | Verify ts2phc metrics cleanup ... | tgm | 1 | infra_other | low | GNSS/ts2phc setup panic before assertions | Retry; check GNSS signal |
| 2 | WPC T-GM holdover through connection loss | tgm | 1 | infra_other | low | GNSS/ts2phc setup panic before assertions | Retry; check GNSS signal |
| 3 | Continuously terminating ts2phc → FREERUN | tgm | 1 | infra_other | low | GNSS/ts2phc setup panic before assertions | Retry; check GNSS signal |
| 4 | T-GM Events on GNSS reboot and recovery | tgm | 1 | infra_other | low | GNSS/ts2phc setup panic before assertions | Retry; check GNSS signal |
| 5 | tbc-serial: slave node rebooted and synced | tbc | 2 | test_flake | medium | No PTP frames → BeforeEach hard-fail at ptp.go:367 | Skip instead of fail when no upstream PTP |
| 6 | dualfollower-serial: one follower port goes down | dualfollower | 3 | test_flake | medium | ens2f1np1 stuck LISTENING >300s post-recovery | Increase timeout at ptptesthelper.go:826 |
| 7 | dualnicbcha: phc2sys secondary switch | dualnicbcha | 4 | test_flake | low | phc2sys failed to switch to secondary interface in time | Extend/retry phc2sys switchover deadline |

## Action Items
1. **Infra/lab team:** Investigate GNSS signal health on tgm nodes (cnfdf30/31/32) and upstream TBC PTP source availability around 02:33 UTC; both tgm and TBC failures point to lab signal instability in the same run window.
2. **Test author (ptp.go):** Change TBC BeforeEach to `Skip` instead of `Fail` when `Ports getting PTP frames=[]`, preventing hard-failing 40+ downstream tests on a transient lab condition.
3. **Test author (ptptesthelper.go:826):** Increase dual-follower SLAVE-recovery timeout beyond 300s (or add a retry with backoff) to reduce environment-dependent flakes.

## Open Questions
- The tgm and TBC failures overlap in time (both appear to lose their upstream PTP/GNSS sources in the same job run). A shared lab-level signal outage is plausible but unverified — no cross-suite timestamp correlation evidence was available. Hypothesis only: if confirmed, both Groups 1 and 2 collapse into a single lab infra event.
- Group 4 (phc2sys) evidence was truncated in the prompt input; confidence is LOW. Per-suite analysis for dualnicbcha should be reviewed directly before acting on that fix.
- No contradictions between per-suite classifications were found; all suites independently converge on flake/transient.
